title: 龙洲经讯Tilly Zhang：国企也受反垄断监管，不只是民企
speaker: Tilly Zhang

segments.en: Tilly, you mentioned something earlier that and I hope you could talk a little bit more about that because I think the messaging that foreign investors will take from that could be important. You mentioned that state owned companies are also the subject of scrutiny that's happening right now.
segments.zh: Tilly，你之前提到国有企业也受到监管审查，外国投资者可能会从中解读出重要信号。

segments.en: Well there are some examples such as the anti-monopoly campaign is sort of a big thing like they want to take down the monopoly behaviors. So like some state owned company such as China Talibao has been advertised on the state administration of market regulation website as well as an example of violating the anti-monopoly rules.
segments.zh: 有一些例子，比如反垄断行动，他们想打击垄断行为。一些国企如中国铁塔也被市场监管总局网站列为违反反垄断规则的案例。

segments.en: So it's not only targeting on private firms but also state owned enterprises can also fall on the scrutiny.
segments.zh: 所以不仅针对民营企业，国有企业也会受到审查。
